content:
Nina (Docs): FYI we're putting together a concise migration alert for customers when v1 endpoints are deprecated. Keep it low-friction: what are the absolute must-haves?
Omar (SDK): must-haves: 1) exact code mapping examples (v1 -> v2) for sync+stream, 2) compat shim snippet, 3) quick list of breaking behaviors (stream shape, embed dims, error codes).
Faye (Product): add billing note (possible change in per-call vs per-token billing) and recommended staging rollout cadence.
Liam (DevEx): I'll prepare a tiny samples/compat folder with smoke tests. PR will include tests that run the shim against staging.
Sam (Support): include the error strings we can search logs for: "ALIAS_NOT_FOUND", "MODEL_ALIAS_DEPRECATED", and a short bullet on embed-dim mismatch detection.
Nina (Docs): draft migration blurb (public):
```
Heads up: We're migrating the public API from v1 to v2. If your integration calls v1 endpoints, update to the v2 Responses API. See the quick code map below. If you need more time, pin to a model version or request a rollback window via support.
```
Omar (SDK): code map snippets: 
```python
# v1 -> v2 mapping (sync)
# v1
resp = client.generate(model='redwood-legacy', input='Hello')
# v2
resp = client.responses.create(model='redwood-2.0', input='Hello')
```
```js
// v1 -> v2 streaming
// v1
client.streamGenerate({ model: 'redwood-legacy' }).on('data', d => console.log(d))
// v2
for await (const ev of client.responses.stream({ model: 'redwood-2.0' })) {
  if (ev.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(ev.delta)
}
```
Liam (DevEx): sample compat shim (goes in samples/compat):
```go
// naive shim: translate old call to new responses API
func GenerateCompat(c *client.Client, model string, prompt string) (*Response, error) {
  return c.Responses.Create(Context{}, map[string]interface{}{ "model": model, "input": prompt })
}
```
Sam (Support): for public FAQ, simple lines: "If you see ALIAS_NOT_FOUND, pin to a specific model or contact support with your org id." We'll keep deeper triage internal.
Faye (Product): timeline: merge docs + samples PRs, wait 24h, then start alias flips in staging. Public notice goes live at merge.
Nina (Docs): PR owners: Nina -> docs notice (PR#), Omar -> SDK README updates + examples, Liam -> samples/compat + smoke tests, Sam -> support canned replies. Ops-bot: run linkcheck and snippet-run on branch `migration/v1-to-v2` when PRs open.
ops-bot: CI queued: linkcheck, snippet-run, smoke-tests for branch migration/v1-to-v2.
Omar (SDK): will add unit tests validating event shapes for streaming deltas so we can assert compatibility in samples.
Liam (DevEx): I'll add a small dashboard to watch for spike in ALIAS_NOT_FOUND and embed-dim mismatch reports. If spike > threshold, auto-post to #incidents.
Nina (Docs): perfect. Short and actionable is the goal. I'll open the docs PR in 30m and drop the snippets above. Thanks! :thumbsup:
